description: Search India's credential-verified mental-health therapist directory. Every result is a professional whose credentials were verified before listing (NMC/RCI register checks, or degree verification for counsellors). All filters optional; names are matched leniently (e.g. city 'Mumbai', concern 'anxiety').

budget_max_inr.description: Max fee per session in INR

city.description: City name for in-person sessions, e.g. 'Mumbai'

concerns.description: Issues to get help with, e.g. ['anxiety', 'grief']

name: search_therapists
title: Search verified therapists
